Hero.tagline: Authentic Italian Flavors in the Heart of London

About.p1: At Andromeda, we bring authentic Italian cuisine to London with handcrafted pizzas, fresh pasta and traditional recipes made with passion. Every dish tells the story of Italy's rich culinary heritage.
About.p2: Our chefs source the finest ingredients directly from Italian producers — San Marzano tomatoes, 00 flour, aged Parmigiano-Reggiano — crafting dishes that transport you straight to the streets of Naples and Rome.
About.imageAlt: Chef at Andromeda preparing Italian cuisine
